source.description: The raw data from which the grid was built.

label.description:
An informative label representing the source of the data. This is meant to be displayed along with the grid
as its title or caption. Typically an abbreviated value type of the data.

description.description: A more detailed description of the source of the data. Typically the full value type of the data.

cols.description:
The column meta information for this grid. Note that this does _not_ include the label as a column.

@see #labelCol

sourceType.description:
The type which all the instances mix in. In most cases, this will be a more specific type than **Obj**.
If the collection is of heterogenous types, it will be a parent type of them all.

title:
This implementation of {@link DataGrid} is based on a collection of {@link Obj} instances. There is one row for
each instance and columns for each of the fields of the Obj. If the collection is a {@link Map} row labels are the
map keys and otherwise row labels are the indices.

If the collection is a {@link Stream}, the totalSize will return `null` until the stream has been exhausted.

Normally only fields are included, but if properties or methods are annotated with `@dataGrid(show=true)`, they
will be included as well.
name: DataGrid.Objs
